verdict.rationale: The evidence documents AI meeting summaries, action items, transcripts, and an API that lets developers pass transcripts to an LLM for tailored recaps. None of it shows Fellow itself drafting a follow-up email for review and quick sending. The API route is a developer building block and the summaries are an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a sales lead, the tool drafts my follow-up email from the meeting so I can review and send it in a couple of clicks
